metadata.kai_tak_processing: Keep the established iB1000 land polygon. Extend east with the CEDD sea-fill complement. Use the CEDD geological coastline in the bounded runway reclamation where the precise sea-fill polygons predate the road. Omit detached land across the approach channel.

wong_tai_sin_district_land.processing: Add the official district footprint and its 50 m inland margin to existing eastern ground. The CEDD mainland polygon establishes land coverage; the flat game terrain does not use elevations.
